prs.title: test: improve mutation and MAC coverage for defu
prs.body:
## Summary

This PR improves the automated test suite for `src/defu.ts` by enhancing mutation testing coverage and adding specific MAC (Mutation Analysis Coverage) tests. These changes ensure higher confidence in the correctness of the default assignment logic.

## Changes

- Added new test cases in `test/defu.mac-mut.test.ts` to target specific mutation scenarios.
- Updated `.ijst-stryker.config.json` to optimize mutation testing configuration.
- Generated updated reports in `reports/`.

## Metrics

| Metric | Before | After | Change |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Coverage | 100% | 100% | 0% |
| Mutation | 79.1% | 89.55% | +10.45% |
| MAC | 79.1 | 89.55 | +10.45 |

## Checklist

- [x] Tests pass
- [x] Mutation score improved
- [x] No breaking changes

constraints: Verify __proto__ and constructor keys are skipped
Verify input objects are not mutated
